provenance.licenceNote: Manufacturer spec page, © DJI. Values quoted for interoperability; no DJI material reproduced.
provenance.notes: Sub-250 g consumer class — the aircraft most likely to be in the sky near a Soldier and most likely to be harmless. Weight is published as '<249 g'.

sensors.obstacleSensing: omnidirectional binocular vision + 3D infrared; forward range 0.5–18 m

rotorCount.basis: Quadcopter form evident from product imagery; not stated on the spec page.

propulsion.basis: Consumer multirotor norm; motor type not published.

remoteId.basis: DJI consumer aircraft broadcast Remote ID in regulated markets; drives the XPDR cue.

cruiseSpeed.basis: Lower bound of arena speed band. Spec publishes only the S-mode maximum; a normal-mode cruise is assumed at ~6 m/s.

signature.visual: small, hovering or slow; white/green strobe and arm LEDs

vulnerability.notes: Sub-250 g; anything kills it. The cost of engaging it is not ammunition, it is a civilian aircraft down.
